captures.shows: Antes de qualquer botão: a tela com os seis estados em branco e o log do backend de validação vazio.
Depois de Copy: a amostra com acentos e emoji no pasteboard de validação, e `set ...` no log nativo.
Depois de Paste: o texto lido é o que o Copy escreveu, emoji incluído.
Depois de uma mudança fora da aplicação, de outro Paste e de Open URL: o backend recebeu a URL exata uma vez.
Depois de dois cliques reais no botão nativo Deep link: dois links numerados, em ordem, cada um ouvido uma vez.
Depois de Vibrate: `Vibrated for 150 ms` e `vibrate 150` no log do backend.
Os caminhos de falha: Copy e Paste com `E_CLIPBOARD_UNAVAILABLE` e o openURL de um backend que recusa com `Unable to open URL: ...`.

regressions.note: run on the tree of the implementation commit before the evidence files were added

decisions: Linking follows iOS's LinkingManager, the contract Linking.js takes when Platform.OS is godot; Clipboard and Vibration use their neutral specs.
A deep link before the runtime exists, or before JS has read Linking, is accepted (deliver_url returns true), counted as unobserved and not buffered.
getInitialURL reads the first valid --uri=<url>: invalid values are skipped, one pair of quotes is removed.
StoppableInvoker is one template in native/stoppable_invoker.h, used by the networking modules and the device services.
The probe runs two applications (a validation backend and Godot's real one) and a second process without --uri=.
The example's Deep link button is a native Godot Button, because deliver_url is a native entry point.
The compatibility audit's Clipboard, Linking and Vibration entries are updated to environment_or_utility_subset.
limitations: Local macOS arm64 evidence; hosted CI is pending and other export targets are separate.
canOpenURL answers by scheme: Godot has no API to ask which handlers are installed.
openURL is synchronous (OS.shell_open) and cannot be cancelled; on macOS the engine reports OK for any URL it is given.
Godot has no vibration cancel or capability query; vibrateByPattern throws if called directly and RN's repeating pattern is not stopped by cancel().
Deep links while the application runs exist only through FabricApplication.deliver_url; the engine emits no event.

The suite replaces every backend that could open a URL, touch the real pasteboard or vibrate: those real effects are not exercised. Only the headless clipboard, the silent desktop vibration and the launch argument are exercised against the real Godot backend.
Alert, Share, Settings and BackHandler, mobile deep-link plugins, Windows and Linux are outside this slice.
This slice is the first of GF-23; it does not complete GF-23 or change roadmap checkpoints.
